title: The Apothecary Diaries Creator Teases New Story Changes for Season 3
content: The Apothecary Diaries has returned to action with its third season of episodes now airing this Fall, and the creator behind it all is teasing some new changes to the story for this next season.
author: ComicBook

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Drops New Sneak Peek Ahead of Netflix Launch – Watch Now
content: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is coming back for a whole new season with Netflix, and the new series is gearing up for its premiere with an early sneak peek clip helping to show it all off. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners might have come to a complete end with its debut , but thankfully that was far from the end of the story.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Super’s Goku Hypes Anime Return With Special Video – Watch
content: Dragon Ball Super is finally making its return to screens with a new anime later this week, and the voice actor behind Goku is sharing their hype for the upcoming premiere with a special new video.
author: ComicBook

title: CloverWorks' Omnibus Anime Film Grotesqqque Previews 'Nocturne' in New Trailer
content: The official YouTube channel for Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) began streaming on Wednesday a trailer for the "Nocturne" story. The video previews the insert song "Tiny Luck" by Kairi Yagi . The film is an omnibus film of three stories with different worldviews.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Creator Returns With Special Tribute for New Shonen Jump Anime Revival
content: A major Shonen Jump series has finally made its official anime adaptation debut 16 years after its cancellation, and the creator behind Black Clover has returned to help celebrate.

title: Gundam: Rogue Orbit Game's Walkthrough Trailer Previews Combat, Customization
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment began streaming a gameplay walkthrough trailer on Tuesday for Gundam Rogue Orbit , a new game in the Gundam franchise , and it previews combat and customization: The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC via Steam on March 5, 2027.
author: ANN

title: Our Blood Oath's Kazu Kakazu Launches Yosuga Tagurite Manga Series
content: This year's 45th issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine announced on Monday that manga creator Kazu Kakazu will launch a new manga titled Yosuga Tagurite on Shueisha 's vertical-scrolling manga service Jump Toon on October 9.
author: ANN

title: emaqi Service Adds Streaming Under My Control, The Soldier Groom and the Daikon Bride, Shin Ikki Tousen, 8 More Manga
content: AI localization company Orange Inc. announced on Tuesday that its emaqi e-bookstore service is adding 11 new exclusive titles this month. Eight of the new titles will be available through its " emaqi Premium" monthly subscription service.
author: ANN

title: Short Net Anime Studio Plott to Start Producing Over-the-Air TV Anime
content: Plott , a production company known for producing short net anime streamed on YouTube , announced on Tuesday its foray into the terrestrial television anime business next year.
